issues.title: WP3 evidence launcher reintroduces retired safe-mode authority
issues.evidence: Batch 29 Windows WP3 tests 43/43 passed, then production evidence failed at backend startup. Source closure identified YANCE_SAFE_MODE in the evidence launcher.
issues.rootCause: tools/wp3/production-api-v2-runtime.js injected YANCE_SAFE_MODE=1 even though runtime_state is the only production authority.
issues.fix: Remove YANCE_SAFE_MODE from the production evidence child environment and add a static authority gate.
issues.verification: Static authority and unique runtime construction tests 2/2 PASS; real Windows production evidence pending.

issues.title: FD6 closure and rejected-owner exit race is misclassified as permanently live containment
issues.evidence: Batch 29 Windows A12, A14, A20 and A21 failed after backend startup failure/cleanup. On Windows the backend can exit from FD6 closure after stop has already reported failure.
issues.rootCause: Cleanup immediately persisted FATAL_OWNER_CONTAINMENT from the stale stop result without a bounded observation of the real child exit and owner registry recovery.
issues.fix: Observe a bounded concurrent-exit grace, wait for durable owner recovery, then resolve to FAILED_SAFE only when child, registry, FD6 and authority are all released. Otherwise remain fail-closed.
issues.verification: Containment/cancellation/journal targeted suite 43/43 PASS including a dedicated Windows FD6-close race test; real Windows matrix pending.

issues.title: Startup cancellation timing was conflated with later child cleanup duration
issues.evidence: Batch 29 targeted Windows test reported ~4.6 seconds although startup-failed IPC had already cancelled the FD5 generation.
issues.rootCause: The oracle measured the entire host.start rejection and process cleanup instead of the authoritative cancellation timestamp.
issues.fix: Record lastStartCancellation at startup-failed/error/host-cancel and assert cancellation latency separately from cleanup.
issues.verification: Targeted startup cancellation tests PASS; real Windows timing pending.

issues.title: WP5 source closure confuses negative probes, prefixed knobs and final identity bindings with legacy authority
issues.evidence: Batch 29 Windows mutation matrix passed 24/24, then source-closure failed five checks.
issues.rootCause: Broad textual regexes scanned negative-injection fixtures/minified same lines and expected final accepted identity fields to remain null.
issues.fix: Add explicit negative-probe exclusions, exact retired-key matching, direct desktopSettings access matching and phase-aware final identity validation.
issues.verification: Source closure 11/11, WP5 base 58/58 and 24/24 mutants KILLED; full continuous Windows verify pending.
